English · 简体中文
dsh-html-annotate
Point at the part of an HTML page you want changed. Send that pointer to the current session as one
of an HTML page you want changed. Send that pointer to the current session as one ordinary message.
> **This repository is a fork of `czxgg0630/dsh-html-annotate`** that adds an editable selection box
: after drawing a region you can drag it, pull any of the eight handles to resize, nudge with the ar
row keys, and delete it with `Delete`. Every change re-samples the elements inside while keeping the

note and style targets you already wrote.
>
> Install from this fork: `dsh plugin --profile <profil
e> add github:daydream-wjh/dsh-html-annotate`
## 本 fork 的改动 / What this fork adds
相对上游 `czxgg0630/dsh-html-annotate`（`0c94bfb`，v0.2.0），本 fork 多了**两个提交**：
| 提交 | 内容 |

| `8bb18c5` | 可编辑的自定义选框：拖动、八向缩放、方向键微调、删除 |
| `298bd9f` | 多格式批注：Markdown / 代码 / CSV / SVG / 图片都能被框选 |
上游文档正文未改，多出来的就是下面这些。第一节写第一个提交（选框），第二节写第二个提交（多格式）。
- **选框画完还能改**：`Shift`+拖动，或工具栏新增的 `⬚`（框选模式）拉出的区域不再是死框。整框可拖动；八个手柄（`nw / n / ne / e / se / s / sw / w`）

改大小，最小 8×8 px；方向键微调 1 px、`Shift`+方向键 10 px；`Delete` / `Backspace` 或框角的 `×` 删除，删除时一并清掉外层草稿。
- **改动后按新
几何重采样**：拖动 / 缩放 / 微调都会用新 `rect` 重新 `collectArea()`，并用 `requestAnimationFrame` 合帧，`mouseup` 与按键时各 `fl

ush` 一次，不会每帧发消息。
- **同一个框不丢已写内容**：每个框带一个 `boxId`，客户端 `decideUpstream` 认到同 `boxId` 的 `area` 消息就原地更新 `

rect` / `items`，`note` 与 `styleTargets` 保留；换框仍按「草稿已占用」拒绝，并且会把上一条未发送的草稿先落盘。
- **同框几何更新绕过消息限速**：否则拖动时每

秒几十条更新会被闸门卡住，框会一卡一卡。
- **框选模式下单击不拖不再误判**：保持原框，不当成点选元素。

| `bridge.js` | +228 / −20 行：`marquee` 选框层（虚线框、尺寸角标、`×` 按钮、八个手柄）、`boxDrag` 拖动/缩放、方向键与 `Delete` 处理、`d

rawMarquee()` 接进 `renderPinned` / `onScroll` / `resize` / DOM 变化的重绘路径；区域选框改由 `marquee` 绘制 |
| `clien
t.js` | +36 / −2 行：`boxId` 从页面透传到草稿、同框原地更新、几何更新绕过限速、工具栏 `⬚` 按钮与 `mode === 'rect'` 模式、`mode.rectTitle

` / `aria.rect` 中英文案 |

## What gets sent
One element, one style change, one note:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This is a plain `session.prompt(..., 'queue')` call, so the message shows up in chat history like an
ything you typed, works on any model, and leaves no hidden channel behind.
Current styles are only listed for the keys you actually changed. The seven keys worth diffing are `
font-size`, `font-weight`, `line-height`, `color`, `background-color`, `padding`, `border-radius`; a
nnotated text, ids and class names are filled with noise if the note is about copy or structure.
The `source` line is a best-effort hint: the plugin reads up to 10 local `.js` / `.css` files refere
nced by the entry page (512 KB of code), looks for the element's text, id and class names, and stops
at the first hit. It names the file only — line numbers drift with every edit and a wrong one costs
more than it saves. Inline scripts, files it cannot read, and strings assembled at runtime may not
be found; the hint is simply omitted then, and the message still sends.
## How it works
The plugin is assembled from DSH capability seams rather than reimplementing them:
| DSH capability | How this plugin uses it |
| `webServer.register()` | The Host half registers one read-only `/html-annotate` prefix route on th

e local Harness server |
| `sessions` + `connection` | The route maps the session id in the URL to t

hat session's workspace root, under the same trust gate as DSH's own web routes |
| `sidebarRightTab
s` service + `sidebar.right.pane.tab` slot | Registers the **HTML annotations** tab, matched only fo

r session-bound `.html` / `.htm` file addresses |
| `remote.workspaceFiles` | The client reads the e
ntry page once to confirm it is reachable and to keep its source for the `source:` hint; the route s

erves the bytes |
| `remote.changes()` stream | Reloads the preview; falls back to backoff polling w

hen the stream is unavailable |
| `session.prompt(content, 'queue')` | Delivers the assembled annota

tion message to the session owning the file |
| `locale` service | Registers the `html-annotate` nam
espace (87 keys per language) and follows live language switches |
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint are out of scope: the built-in preview keeps them. This plugin onl
y claims formats it can turn into an annotatable DOM.
- The frame is sandboxed without `allow-same-origin`, so `sessionStorage` / `localStorage` throw ins
ide it. Pages that persist state there degrade to in-memory; pages that read them without a `try/cat

ch` lose that handler.
- Only files under the session's workspace root are served. Absolute-path add
resses (`absolute/...`) keep going to the built-in preview, which is a static snapshot and does not

run page scripts the same way.
- The page's own remote references load natively — CDN styles, script
s and images included. That is the point of a real preview, and it also means the preview makes netw

ork requests the Harness does not mediate.
- Navigation inside the frame stays inside the plugin: fo
llowing a link to an external site loads that site without the annotation bridge, so annotation stop

s working there.
- The change stream is best effort; when it is unavailable the preview falls back t

o polling with exponential backoff up to 20 seconds.
- No screenshots are taken. What the model sees
is structure, text and computed styles.
## Compatibility

| DSH | `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0` (`engines.dsh`) |
| Surface | Web GUI right sidebar (`dsh.client.platfo

rm: "web"`); headless and TUI profiles have no sidebar |
| Node | `>=20`, tests only |
